report.summary: Layout elements are incorrectly arranged side-by-side on a mobile viewport, causing horizontal overflow and truncation of content.
report.severity_reason: Crucial interactive elements and text are cut off at the edge of the screen, making the interface partially unusable on mobile devices.

visual_evidence.observation: The 'Checkout' card is positioned horizontally next to the 'Join the Hackathon' card, causing it to extend beyond the right edge of the viewport.
The text on the green button ('Continue to...') is truncated at the right edge of the screen.
The 'BugLens' and 'RepoMedic' cards are arranged in a horizontal row instead of stacking vertically.

possible_causes.why: The .card class has a hardcoded width of 520px, which is too wide for most mobile viewports and prevents responsive stacking.
The side-by-side arrangement suggests the use of a flexbox container that lacks 'flex-wrap: wrap', forcing items to stay on a single line and overflow the screen.

investigate: Check all CSS classes for fixed pixel widths.
Inspect parent containers of the cards for 'display: flex' and ensure 'flex-wrap: wrap' is applied.
Review media queries to ensure styles adjust appropriately for mobile screen widths.
uncertainties: The provided code snippet only includes the 'Join the Hackathon' card, while the screenshot shows other components (BugLens banner, Projects section) not present in the source code.
It is not possible to confirm if the layout is driven by Flexbox, CSS Grid, or inline-block elements without seeing the full HTML structure.

fixes.before: width: 520px; /* BUG: too wide for mobile */
